description: Figure Series in non-verbal reasoning involves a sequential group of figures that follow a specific rule. The objective is to analyze the given pattern and determine the next figure in the series.

sections.title: Rotation and Direction
sections.description: Understanding the rotation patterns of figures or their internal elements.

key_concepts.explanation: Movement of elements in the direction of clock hands.
Movement of elements in the opposite direction of clock hands.
Sequential turning of figures at a fixed mathematical angle.

sections.title: Displacement of Elements
sections.description: Rules governing the position shifting of small elements within a main figure.

results: Elements move forward along corners or sides in a specific, continuous order.
After completing one full cycle, elements return to their exact initial positions.
At each consecutive step of the series, an old existing element disappears.
A completely new element appears in its place or at a newly designated position.

sections.title: Change in Number of Elements
sections.description: Sequential increase or decrease in the number of internal figures or lines.

results: The main sides of the polygon increase sequentially (e.g., Triangle, Square, Pentagon).
Alternatively, the total number of line segments decreases in a fixed, predictable pattern.
The total number of internal or external dots follows an arithmetic pattern like +1, +2, +3 or -1, -2.

sections.title: Mirror and Water Image Concepts
sections.description: Sequential application of mirror or water images to figures within the series.

key_concepts.explanation: The left part of the figure becomes right and the right part becomes left, while the top and bottom remain absolutely identical.
The top part of the figure becomes bottom and the bottom part becomes top, while the left and right sides remain completely unchanged.

sections.title: Solving Strategy
sections.description: A structured approach to solve figure series questions with maximum speed and accuracy.

steps.title: Select one element
steps.detail: Instead of looking at the complex whole figure at once, isolate and focus on just one single small element or symbol.

steps.title: Track the pattern
steps.detail: Carefully observe and define the rule of direction, position shifting, and transformation happening specifically to that selected element.

steps.title: Eliminate options
steps.detail: Immediately cross out the multiple-choice options that do not reflect the exact pattern you just discovered for that element.
